added.question: According to the biblical account of creation, what did God create on the second day of creation?
By what name is the celestial sign known that, according to the Gospel of Matthew, guided the wise men from the East to the child in Bethlehem?
Which son of Adam and Eve, born after Cain had murdered Abel, was named by Eve as God's replacement for Abel and became the ancestor of Noah?
How many baskets of leftovers were gathered after Jesus had fed the five thousand with five loaves and two fish?
In which Spanish city's cathedral is the agate cup kept that is venerated as the Holy Grail, the chalice of the Last Supper?
What is the name of the small, usually round container in which a priest carries consecrated hosts to the sick and housebound?
According to Genesis, how many people survived the Flood in Noah's ark?
What is the Monday before Ash Wednesday called, the high point of the Rhineland carnival with its great parades in Cologne, Düsseldorf and Mainz?
Which transverse arm of a church crosses the main body just before the chancel, giving the floor plan the shape of a cross?
Which of his few possessions did Diogenes throw away after he saw a boy drinking water from his cupped hands?
What is the name of the 1302 bull in which Pope Boniface VIII declared that submission to the Roman Pontiff is absolutely necessary for the salvation of every human creature?
For which Latin blessing do the letters C+M+B officially stand, which carol singers chalk above front doors around the feast of the Epiphany?
Which British philosopher was sentenced in 1918 to six months in Brixton Prison for an anti-war article and wrote his "Introduction to Mathematical Philosophy" there?
By which Greek name, formed from the words for "five" and "scroll case", do scholars call the five books of Moses?
